findings.title: Test suite is non-hermetic: fixed-path data-dir hijack plus import-time credit-ledger capture make CI green/red depend on machine state
paths: backend/tos_credits/credits.py (CREDITS_DIR computed and mkdir'd once at module import — violates the codebase's own B.6 lazy-path pattern)
backend/tests/test_ids.py (fixture email draws the shared ledger)
findings.first_observed: Latent since before baseline (credits semantics + history test both pre-date the WPs); surfaced by repeated evidence runs on 2026-10-19
findings.fix_summary: NOT ADDRESSED BY WP-1..WP-10 and discovered during evidence generation. Chain: the history test unconditionally hijacks TOSCANINI_DATA_DIR to a FIXED path at import; tos_credits captures CREDITS_DIR (and mkdirs it) at first module import; every full-suite run therefore draws exactly 1 credit from one persistent per-machine ledger. The deny rule is remaining >= cost(5) and each run decrements remaining by 1, so on any machine where the fixed path survives, the suite turns red from the 7th run onward (402 'No GPU credits remaining') and never self-heals. Reproduced both regimes at 014b155: fresh-runner conditions 355 passed / exit 0; depleted-ledger conditions 354 passed / 1 failed / exit 1. Not a product-logic regression — the 402 path is intended behavior.
evidence: 06_ci/final_rerun.txt (both regimes, root cause, ledger evidence)
bisection: green with tests/test_ids.py alone; green on fresh ledger; red with tests/test_credit_bridge.py+tests/test_history_endpoints.py+tests/test_ids.py on depleted ledger
